profile.overview: House Dimir is the blue-black Ravnican guild whose source-backed identity centers secrecy, deception, spies, assassins, manipulation, secrets, and backroom deals.
profile.philosophy: Dimir turns information into hidden leverage through secrecy, backroom dealing, observation, and delayed disclosure.
profile.core_tension: Dimir is most itself when information advantage stays concealed; generic UB control, mill, discard, theft, or evasion does not prove the guild on its own.
profile.social_or_institutional_role: The official guide frames Dimir around secrecy, spies, assassins, manipulation, secrets, backroom deals, and Lazav as guildmaster in that era.
profile.mechanics_and_play_pattern: Surveil is Dimir mechanical texture because it filters future information by choosing what stays on top of the library and what goes to the graveyard.
profile.placement_use: Use this profile to support thematic placement, quiz design, and lore browsing. Do not present placement inferences as canon.

limitations: Dimir semantic readiness is bounded to the listed official overview, mechanics, and prerelease sources.

great_tension.placement_relevance: Used to distinguish source-backed Dimir secrecy and hidden leverage from generic UB mechanics, public institutions, spectacle, undercity survival, or rhetoric.
